title: Taming Softmax at the Limits of Muon: A Unified Approach through Hilbert Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.17588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Muon controls weight updates through the RMS movement of a linear layer's output. This implicitly treats the linear output as a proxy for the full module, including the nonlinearity that follows. This proxy can be misleading for softmax, where the RMS shift in activations does not faithfully measure the change in the output distribution. We propose Hilbert distance as a natural metric for bounding changes in these output distributions. Hilbert distance bounds changes in cross-entropy loss and limits probability redistribution. For softmax, it takes the form of the variation seminorm of the preactivation perturbation, allowing probability constraints to be expressed as parameter constraints. Formulating the steepest descent problem with a Hilbert distance constraint brings two recently proposed methods under a unified mathematical framework. For the LM head, solving a row-wise approximation to the resulting diameter-constrained problem

translated_title: 在Muon的极限处驯服Softmax：基于希尔伯特几何的统一方法
translated_abstract: Muon优化器通过线性层输出的RMS（均方根）移动来控制权重更新，这隐含地将线性输出视为整个模块（包括其后的非线性部分）的代理。然而，这种代理对于softmax而言可能产生误导，因为激活值的RMS偏移并不能忠实地度量输出分布的变化。我们提出希尔伯特距离作为约束这些输出分布变化的自然度量。希尔伯特距离能够约束交叉熵损失的变化并限制概率的重新分配。对于softmax，它表现为预激活扰动的变差半范数，从而使概率约束可以表达为参数约束。通过引入希尔伯特距离约束来表述最速下降问题，可以将两种最近提出的方法纳入统一的数学框架。对于语言模型输出头（LM head），可以通过求解所得直径约束问题的逐行近似来加以应用。
tldr: 提出希尔伯特距离作为约束softmax输出分布变化的自然度量，使概率约束得以转化为参数约束，并将两种最近提出的基于Muon的优化方法统一到同一数学框架之下。
en_tdlr: Proposes Hilbert distance as a natural metric for bounding changes in softmax output distributions, turning probability constraints into parameter constraints and unifying two recently proposed Muon-based methods under a single mathematical framework.
